PDF 与笔记，保存在本机: PDFs and notes, on your Mac
独立查看笔记: Open note in a separate window
给下一篇论文，留一处思考的空间。: A place to think through your next paper.
阅读、摘录与笔记，在同一个原生工作台。: Read, collect evidence, and take notes in one workspace.
拖动框选 PDF 区域 · Esc 取消: Drag to capture a PDF region · Esc to cancel
每篇论文都有一份独立的 Markdown 笔记。\n摘录和截图可以一键回到原文。:
Every paper has its own Markdown note.
Quotes and captures link back to the source.
自动识别不准时可手动指定栏。扫描 PDF 暂无 OCR。: Choose a column manually if detection is inaccurate. OCR is not available for scanned PDFs.
扫描页面：请手动指定阅读区域: Scanned page: choose a reading region manually
确认后应用，可在笔记中撤销。: Apply after reviewing. You can undo this change in the note.
使用本机 Codex 登录；模型推理可能在云端。Shell、文件写入和外部插件不: Uses your local Codex sign-in; inference may run in the cloud. Shell, file writes, and external plugins are disabled.
联网检索使用 Crossref 的真实出版物信息。笔记修改始终需要差异确认。AP: Search retrieves real publications from Crossref. Note changes always require diff approval. API keys are stored only in macOS Keychain.
修改后立即用于菜单栏、工具栏与右键菜单。Cmd+P 保留为打印。: Changes apply to menus, toolbars, and context menus. Cmd+P remains Print.
清空按键可取消绑定。编辑器保留常用文本编辑键。: Clear a key to remove its binding. Standard text editing shortcuts remain available.
该组合保留给 macOS 标准命令。: This shortcut is reserved for a standard macOS command.
该组合保留给 macOS 隐藏或最小化窗口。: This shortcut is reserved for hiding or minimizing windows.
该组合保留给系统截图或重做。: This shortcut is reserved for system screenshots or Redo.
请输入一个字符，并选择至少一个修饰键。: Enter one character and select at least one modifier.
发生保存冲突 · 编辑已有副本: Save conflict · Your edits have been preserved
截图已保存到原论文资源文件夹；论文切换后未自动插入。: The capture was saved with the original paper. It was not inserted after you switched papers.
请先在 PDF 中选择要摘录的文字。: Select text in the PDF before quoting it.
未检测到 DOI，可在文献信息中手动填写。: No DOI detected. You can enter one in Paper information.
将 Markdown 导入当前笔记？: Import Markdown into the current note?
当前笔记会保留在 note.previous.md。相对路径的 PNG、JPEG: The current note will be preserved as note.previous.md. Relative PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP images will be copied into the paper’s assets folder.
导出包含 note.md 和 assets 的独立文件夹: Export a separate folder containing note.md and assets
论文已切换，请在当前笔记中重新导出。: The paper changed. Export again from the current note.
编辑器尚未就绪: The editor is not ready yet.
编辑器无法读取这份笔记。: The editor could not open this note.
无法插入笔记，请先打开可编辑的论文笔记。: Open an editable paper note before inserting content.
笔记窗口尚未准备好，或另一个导出仍在进行。: The note window is not ready, or another export is in progress.
图片或字体尚未加载完成，请检查笔记资源后重试。: Images or fonts have not finished loading. Check the note’s assets and try again.
编辑器进程已重新启动，正在从最近的编辑内容恢复。: The editor process restarted. Restoring your latest edits.
无法读取这个 PDF 文件。: This PDF could not be opened.
找不到论文文件。: The paper file could not be found.
笔记已被其他程序修改。你的编辑已保存在冲突副本中，请重新打开论文以读取外部版本。: Another app changed the note. Your edits were preserved in a conflict copy. Reopen the paper to load the external version.
资源路径不在允许的目录内。: The asset path is outside the allowed folder.
截图区域过大，请选择较小区域。: The capture region is too large. Select a smaller region.
无法读取 Keychain 中的 API Key。: The API key could not be read from Keychain.
无法将 API Key 保存到 Keychain。: The API key could not be saved to Keychain.
笔记修改内容不能为空。: The proposed note content cannot be empty.
笔记已发生变化，请重新生成差异，避免覆盖你的编辑。: The note changed. Generate a new diff to avoid overwriting your edits.
请配置有效的模型和 HTTPS 服务地址。: Configure a valid model and HTTPS endpoint.
模型服务请求失败，HTTP %@。请检查配置与账户权限。: The model request failed (HTTP %@). Check your settings and account access.
模型请求了未经授权的工具。: The model requested an unauthorized tool.
工具调用次数已达到限制，请缩小问题范围。: The tool-call limit was reached. Ask a more focused question.
Codex App Server 连接已关闭。: The Codex App Server connection closed.
Codex App Server 请求超时。: The Codex App Server request timed out.
Codex App Server 未连接。: Codex App Server is not connected.
这份 PDF 没有内嵌目录。: This PDF has no embedded outline.
找到候选文献，请在文献信息中确认。: A candidate publication was found. Review it in Paper information.
未检测到 DOI 或 arXiv ID，可手动填写文献信息。: No DOI or arXiv ID detected. You can enter the paper information manually.
点击按键框录制；Delete 清除，Esc 取消。编辑器保留常用文本编辑键。: Click a shortcut to record it; Delete clears, Esc cancels. Standard text editing keys are preserved.
整屏变暗。单击锁定阅读行，↑/↓移动；再次单击跟随鼠标。Esc 退出。: Dim every screen. Click to pin a line, use ↑/↓ to move, and click again to follow the mouse. Esc exits.
询问论文或当前选区…: Ask about the paper or selection…
公式与图表识别需要支持视觉的模型。: Equation and figure recognition requires a vision-capable model.
扫描页面使用区域聚焦；可手动指定阅读栏。: Scanned page: using region focus. You can choose a reading column manually.
名称不能为空，也不能包含斜杠或换行。: Enter a name without slashes or line breaks.
拖入 PDF 或将论文移动到此处: Drop PDFs or move papers here
拖入 PDF，或新建文件夹整理文献。: Drop PDFs or create a folder to organize papers.
更新通过 HTTPS 下载，并在安装前验证签名。自动检查可随时关闭。: Updates download over HTTPS and their signatures are verified before installation. You can turn off automatic checks at any time.
iCloud 冲突版本已保留为独立副本，可在笔记所在文件夹查看。: iCloud conflict versions were preserved as separate files in the note folder.
iCloud 文件正在下载或暂不可用，请联网后稍候重试。: An iCloud file is downloading or unavailable. Connect to the internet and try again shortly.
原始文件夹不是空的。请先移动其中的文件，或在 Finder 中管理。: The original folder is not empty. Move its files first, or manage it in Finder.
在 iCloud Drive 中新建工作区时，会复制当前文献库；选择已有工作区则: A new iCloud workspace receives a copy of your current library. Existing workspaces open directly. Choose the same folder on another Mac signed in to the same Apple Account.
在 iCloud Drive 中选择或新建 Paper Reader 文件夹。原: Choose or create a Paper Reader folder in iCloud Drive. Your original library will be retained.
打开文件夹会按原有层级显示 PDF；关联笔记、图片与批注保存在该文件夹的 .pa: Open a folder to browse its PDFs in their original hierarchy. Linked notes, images and annotations live in its .paper-reader directory.
正在准备工作区，原文献库会保留…: Preparing workspace. Your original library will be retained…
选择已有的论文文件夹，按原有层级打开 PDF。: Choose an existing paper folder to browse its PDFs in place.
已保存在本机 · 等待 iCloud 上传: Saved locally · waiting for iCloud upload
请选择 iCloud Drive 中的文件夹。普通本地文件夹不会自动同步到 iC: Choose a folder in iCloud Drive. An ordinary local folder does not automatically sync to iCloud.
工作区文献信息不完整或已损坏，请检查 .paper-reader 中的 pape: Workspace metadata is incomplete or damaged. Check paper.json in .paper-reader.
文件版本与本机草稿不同。两份内容已分别备份，可选择要继续编辑的版本。: The file and local draft differ. Both versions have been backed up. Choose the version to continue editing.
文件保存失败 · 本机草稿已保留: File save failed · Local draft retained
保存失败 · 请保留窗口并检查磁盘: Save failed · Keep this window open and check your disk
PDF、笔记、资源、批注与文件夹信息参与同步。SQLite、阅读位置、API 密: PDFs, notes, assets, annotations and folders sync. SQLite, reading positions, API keys and AI chats stay on this Mac. Downloaded files work offline. Detected note conflicts retain copies and are not automatically merged.
柔边矩形包含当前行与上下文。单击固定，↑/↓移动，再次单击跟随鼠标。Esc 退出: A soft rectangle contains the current line and its context. Click to pin, use ↑/↓ to move, and click again to follow the mouse. Esc exits.
自动阅读按栏前进。上下箭头暂停播放并移动，切换应用后自动暂停。: Automatic reading follows column order. Arrow keys pause playback and move. Switching apps pauses playback.
Codex 路径不可执行，请在 AI 设置中选择已安装的 Codex。: The Codex path is not executable. Choose your installed Codex in AI settings.
Enter 发送 · Shift+Enter 换行: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
解释选区、梳理方法，或一起整理笔记。: Explain a selection, examine the method, or organize your notes.
请总结这篇论文的方法、主要结论和局限，并标注原文页码。: Summarize this paper’s methods, main findings and limitations, citing the original page numbers.
